Star Polymer
============

.. autofunction:: snap_simulate.system.molecules.make_star_polymer

YAML Configuration Example
--------------------------

.. code-block:: yaml

   molecule_type: "star_polymer"
   beads_per_arm: 3
   num_arms: 6
   center_type: 0
   arm_type: 1
   end_type: 2
   bond_type: 0
   num_molecules: 10
